title: RMS Titanic sinks in the North Atlantic
summary: The British liner Titanic, on its maiden voyage, sank in the early hours after striking an iceberg, and more than 1,500 people died.
reason: The ship was steaming fast through an ice field and carried lifeboats for only about half of those aboard.
significance: The disaster led to major reforms in maritime safety, including the first SOLAS convention.
place: North Atlantic Ocean, south of Newfoundland
